[SWS_DM_02171] Operation
execution without required proxim-
ity_challenge
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If a SOVD method to execute an operation is received and the
DiagnosticSovd-
Operation.proximityProofRequired
is set to
TRUE
and the SOVD request body
does not contain a
proximity_response
, the DM shall deny the request and return
an SOVD error 400 (Bad Request).
⌋
